installs.name: spark25
installs.note: 16q/4kv head_dim 256, fused q|k|v as one resident tensor; measured 2026-10-29

default on (2026-10-29 flip): the GQA-shared decode kernel read +3.88% on spark25 at 16q/4kv/head_dim 256; TURBOSPARK_ATTN_DECODE_KERNEL=barrier restores it and is the sweep's kill arm

open_questions: the GQA decode default (2026-10-29 flip) rests on timing and 64-token greedy identity only: run a dense_kl gate on spark25 with TURBOSPARK_ATTN_DECODE_KERNEL=barrier against unset
